hero.intro: Started out on film sets. Now I make founders, brands and products hard to scroll past by strengthening their social presence through strategic content creation and creative storytelling, driving visibility, engagement, and growth. (Same job, really)

projects.name: Miles Ukaoma
projects.meta: Founder brand · LinkedIn · Podcast · Aug 2025 → present
projects.hook: A former Olympian turned AI thought leader.
projects.brief: A Rio 2016 Olympian and SVP of Marketing at Quilt with a sharp mind, great stories, and even greater ideas. The job was to put out content that speaks to his target audience and bring in people who wants to learn, build a and educate themselves on AI.

did.title: Content Strategy and Personal Branding
did.body: For someone like Miles, there is a lot of wisdom and knowledge behind those eyes. To intricately work on the kind of content and information that he wants to put out. I did heavy research on competitors, took inspiration from 'professional creators' and prepared scripts for the run. It involved curating a podcast, preparing questionnaires, giving guidance on online presence, giving talking points to make authentic posts, preparing and executing content calendars, and ghostwriting his social media posts.

did.title: Miles' Voice
did.body: One of the toughest challenges was to write copies in the voice of Miles Ukaoma. So... I prepared a voice skill! It followed the nuances in Miles' speech through training an AI model that could always bring me a drafted copy of a post from the context of the video/content that we are going to post.

did.title: CrispyMile
did.body: Miles Ukaoma and Chris DuBois have a lot to share with the world. An ex Olympian and a former soldier talk about different disciplines and practices that goes into being a successful individual as well carry those skills into making a better company. I shaped the format, prepared questionnaires and hosted the podcast.

did.title: Weekly content
did.body: Since December 2025 I run the whole loop: research, script, edit, publish, read the numbers and doing it all over again...but better.

projects.result: More reach, and a voice that's unmistakably his. Miles now shows up as the AI thinker and innovator he set out to be, and the audience keeps growing with him.

projects.name: GotCOS
projects.hook: An open-source AI chief of staff (COS) that is constantly being upgraded with new wearable techs.
projects.bigCaption: users have signed up and started using the app.
projects.brief: An open-source AI chief of staff, built by an Olympian. Isn't that intriguing? What's special about this is that it is not just a software that helps keep track of your work and meetings. It is your personal assistant that prepares ahead of your schedules. Combined with wearable tech, the goal is to make productivity much, much more efficient.

did.title: Promotional Content
did.body: Built the content strategy around one line: “high performers build better systems”. So the best way was to showcase the app from the beginning to its current state through tutorials and updates that addresses the new features and user feedbacks.

did.title: The launch videos and hackathon
did.body: Scripted and edited the product videos that went out with it and prepared assets for the GotCOS hackathon (TBA).

projects.result: 350+ people run their week on it now, and a building community that brings in new/interesting use-cases to work on.

projects.name: Hermitcrabs
projects.hook: 300+ websites built and almost no public knowledge of it. Created videos showcasing HermitCrabs’ digital solutions and products, highlighting the agency’s expertise and the value it delivers to clients.
projects.brief: A HubSpot CMS development and design agency with 300+ websites behind it. Phenomenal work and the amazing people behind the company needs to be seen.

did.title: HubSpot Yearly conference (INBOUND 25/UNBOUND 26)
did.body: The event films: concept, script, voice-over, edit and motion.

did.title: Product walkthroughs
did.body: Videos that serves as an easy to learn alternative for the product builds made by the company showing clients exactly what they're getting.

did.title: Content strategy
did.body: Every company has one strong aspect. Its employees are its talent and spokesperson. Came up with campaigns that focuses on content that highlights the people behind the output given to satisfied clients.

projects.result: Elevating the agency’s brand presence by showcasing impactful work, highlighting its unique culture, building credibility with potential clients, and converting audience engagement into qualified leads and new business opportunities.

projects.name: Forward Company
projects.meta: AI agency · Brand Designer · Jun 2026 → present
projects.hook: Help businesses become AI native. At Forward, we don't sell what we don't use.
projects.brief: An AI-first agency that aims to make companies find where the leak is and help increase their work efficiency. Replace repetitive work with intelligent workflows, connected AI systems, and products that help every team move faster.

did.title: Campaign ideas
did.body: Conducted in-depth competitive research across multiple agencies to analyse their positioning, campaign strategies, and creative approaches, translating key insights into strategic campaigns that strengthened the agency’s market positioning and brand differentiation.

did.title: Promotional posters and content
did.body: Created eye-catching posters following the brand identity and planned the content calendar post launch.

did.title: Launch videos
did.body: Owned the end-to-end creative process, from conceptualisation and scripting to editing, crafting company introduction videos that communicate the brand’s identity, values, and vision while establishing a compelling first impression with potential clients.

projects.result: A cohesive brand identity and a clear market presence, establishing the agency’s voice, communicating its value proposition, and creating a strong foundation for brand recognition and client acquisition.

Was part of the repeating cast of the famous Tamil comedy channel.

Led content creation across event films, product announcements, and product walkthroughs, while developing video assets, content strategies, and scripts to strengthen the agency's brand communication.

Developed campaign concepts, designed promotional creatives, produced launch videos, and crafted LinkedIn copy to establish the AI-first agency’s brand identity, communicate its positioning, and build a cohesive digital presence from day one.
